observations.anatomy: This sea star has five regenerating arms and a skeleton built from movable ossicles.

landmarks.root: Outer edge of central disc
landmarks.extent: Five distal arm tips
landmarks.profile: Rays carry external spines and underside foot rows

inference.geometry: Blend ray roots into the disc, leaving full valleys between adjacent rays.
inference.missing_evidence: Get a scale-bearing oral and aboral pair to measure arm taper, disc diameter and cross-section.

observations.anatomy: Ventral foot rows run along sea-star arms and extend and retract as part of the water-vascular system.

landmarks.root: Rows flanking the arm's radial canal
landmarks.extent: Distal attachment pad
landmarks.profile: Soft extensible column under the arm

inference.geometry: Use a repeated column with a widened terminal contact disc and one extension control.
inference.missing_evidence: Compare loaded and retracted feet in a side macro for length and pad proportions.

observations.anatomy: Small pedicellariae sit about spine bases and clear debris.

landmarks.root: Spine base on aboral body wall
landmarks.extent: Tips of tiny opposed jaws
landmarks.profile: Clustered surface projections

inference.geometry: Treat the jaws as local details repeated as a cluster, with fixed states before articulation.
inference.missing_evidence: Measure the jaws under magnification and determine a useful minimum rendered size.

observations.anatomy: The test is rigid and fused, surrounding the body with pores that transmit tube feet.

landmarks.root: Oral base of the test around the mouth
landmarks.extent: Aboral pole
landmarks.profile: Rigid plate-bearing, rounded enclosure

inference.geometry: Plan discrete foot bands around an oblate body rather than cut random surface pores.
inference.missing_evidence: Find taxon-specific meridional and polar views to establish plate boundaries and profile.

observations.anatomy: Long spines project from the test and contribute to movement and defense.

landmarks.root: External test surface
landmarks.extent: Individual spine tips
landmarks.profile: Long tapered projections over a rounded body

inference.geometry: Use normal-based poles for the spine field and defer joint geometry.
inference.missing_evidence: Inspect pivot bases and spine-length variation across the oral and aboral hemispheres.

observations.anatomy: The scraping mechanism under the test is organized in five parts.

landmarks.root: Centre of oral face
landmarks.extent: Converging scraping tips
landmarks.profile: Small radial set of mineralized elements

inference.geometry: Expose only the oral tooth tips in a closed external model.
inference.missing_evidence: Check open and closed oral specimen diagrams to establish which elements are exterior.

observations.anatomy: A chiton dorsum is armored by a serial set of shell plates held in the mantle girdle.

landmarks.root: Valve beds along dorsal longitudinal midline
landmarks.extent: First to last shell plate
landmarks.profile: Cross-body plate arches with fore-aft overlap

inference.geometry: Make stacked curved plates within a single host strip so bending preserves overlap.
inference.missing_evidence: Compare a common exposed-plate chiton in straight and curved profile views.

observations.anatomy: A broad muscular foot is flanked by mantle grooves containing the gills.

landmarks.root: Ventral body region within the mantle margins
landmarks.extent: Front and rear pedal limits
landmarks.profile: Flattened continuous sole

inference.geometry: Blend a continuous underside sole into the core with a shallow boundary line.
inference.missing_evidence: Document an underside view for sole-to-body width and the turn-up at its ends.

observations.anatomy: An external coiled chambered shell surrounds the body and opens at the exposed soft head and arms.

landmarks.extent: Remaining coiled shell and the anterior aperture lip
landmarks.profile: Bilaterally balanced whorl with a lateral umbilical region

inference.geometry: Use an expanding whorl cross-section, retaining the full aperture rim as a fit landmark.
inference.missing_evidence: Compare lateral and frontal shell views for whorl spacing and aperture aspect ratio.

observations.anatomy: The labelled protective hood sits at the upper face of the shell opening above the tentacle group.

landmarks.root: Upper soft head near the shell lip
landmarks.extent: Forward edge over the tentacle bases
landmarks.profile: Broad cover fitting the aperture

inference.geometry: Model aperture contact separately from the bending movement of the hood.
inference.missing_evidence: Compare emerged and closed animals in matching frontal and lateral photographs.

observations.anatomy: Multiple flexible external tentacles project around the mouth; the form differs from an eight-arm octopus crown.

landmarks.root: Circumoral region beneath the hood
landmarks.extent: Many narrow free tentacle tips
landmarks.profile: Dense group projecting anteriorly

inference.geometry: Test a clustered set of tapered digits with shared deployment state.
inference.missing_evidence: Verify the arrangement of tentacle sheaths with an anterior anatomical plate.

landmarks.root: Two neighboring barb shafts lie on opposite margins of the local seam.

observations.anatomy: A flexible perimeter around the spiny dorsal field contracts inward around the tucked underside. Closing the perimeter requires a deforming rim with inward roll, distinct from tilting individual spines.

landmarks.root: Short antennal articulation in front of the eye region.
landmarks.extent: Rounded distal antennal plate held ahead of the fourth article.
landmarks.profile: Proximally thick convex plate and a flatter broad free distal edge.

inference.geometry: One flattened antennal assembly with its proximal attachment and coarse plate seams.
inference.missing_evidence: The overhead illustration exposes the outline and overlap but not the hidden articulation or plate underside. Cephalic fit, opposite-antenna clearance and measured thickness remain open.

observations.anatomy: An elongated flattened tibia and tarsus bear a directional fringe that spreads into a blade and collapses along the leg for recovery.

landmarks.root: Hind tibia and distal hinge
landmarks.extent: tapered distal paddle outline
additional: external setal row and coarse supporting inner row
landmarks.profile: flattened first and second tarsomere. external setal row and coarse supporting inner row

inference.geometry: One distal hindleg with coarse deployable fringe, its base and tarsal joint.
inference.missing_evidence: The same-family Corixa punctata replaces the initial Sigara striata reference because its tarsal plates and fringe motions are documented. Hairs and joint range are coarsened. Hydrodynamic output and flexible contact are unverified.

observations.anatomy: A flexible adhesive face projects from the distal palp and folds back into a bordered terminal recess.

landmarks.root: Distal palpal tarsus
landmarks.extent: rounded exposed contact face
landmarks.profile: upper and lower lips. recessed common pad opening

inference.geometry: One distal palp housing and coarse eversible adhesive pad.
inference.missing_evidence: Galeodes araneoides is an observed congener of the original G. arabs lead. The static pose control approximates exposure. Internal inversion, adhesive action, and detailed cuticle remain unverified.

observations.anatomy: Paired second antennae extend as curved setose scoops that project ahead of a buried head and fold inward toward its ventral side.

landmarks.root: Secondary antennal socket
landmarks.extent: tapered recurving tip
landmarks.profile: upright curved main flagellum. inward facing double plumose rows

inference.geometry: One curved secondary antenna with coarse setal field and a mirrored partner.
inference.missing_evidence: Only one antenna is authored and can be mirrored. Depth, exact feather count and folded oral reach remain inferred. Capture performance is unverified.

observations.anatomy: Dorsal and anal fin membranes continue around the very tip through a caudal sector, preserving continuous ray-supported edging across a tight reversal. Verify whether a linked extension of the axial membrane draft can cover the terminal seam.

landmarks.root: Axial root continuous with the lower and upper fins in the rear trunk.
landmarks.extent: One flexible fin margin wraps from the upper edge around the rounded tip to the lower edge.
landmarks.profile: Caudally swept surface ray relief on the longitudinal strips transitions into the fan of the terminal region. All surface geometry remains on a shared axial envelope.

inference.geometry: The rear taper and a continuous rayed membrane around its terminal contour.
inference.missing_evidence: Ray relief stands in for pliable ray structure. Side-to-side thickness, exact ray attachments and 3D ray paths are inferred. Species-matched bent close-up remains unavailable.

observations.anatomy: A narwhal tusk carries a continuous raised left-handed helix around the axis of a tapering shaft.

landmarks.root: Broad end of the tapering shaft; fantasy skull seat inferred.
landmarks.extent: Single narrow tip on the axis of the taper.
landmarks.profile: Continuous helical relief crossing progressively narrower sections.

inference.geometry: Single tapered forehead horn with one raised spiral.
inference.missing_evidence: The forehead mounting, enlarged spiral relief and final curvature belong to the original fantasy design. Fit on a forehead and measured design correspondence remain pending.

observations.anatomy: The preserved pterosaur tail vane broadens on both sides of distal caudal vertebrae and spans a flattened surface.

landmarks.root: Vane narrows onto the terminal caudal shaft.
landmarks.extent: Continuous margins converge on the remote caudal tip.
landmarks.profile: Broad blade bounded by bilateral edges and carried by the central caudal axis.

inference.geometry: Rounded spade-shaped tail tip with an integrated tapered stalk.
inference.missing_evidence: The hooked shoulders and stylized thickness belong to the fantasy design. Exported tail articulation and clearance under large neighboring tail bends remain pending.

observations.anatomy: The frilled lizard ruff has paired flexible lobes with raised radial ridges and valley folds.

landmarks.root: Concentrated attachment along the inside edge.
landmarks.extent: Free membrane margin between radial folds.
landmarks.profile: Thin membrane interrupted by alternating ridges and valleys.

inference.geometry: One small swept cheek membrane with radial relief and a single fleshy root.
inference.missing_evidence: Cheek mounting, four fantasy support ridges and three scallops are design choices. Spread is a shape control. Host clearance, driven motion and calibrated design likeness remain pending.

observations.stage: Domestic pig, live specimen age unverified and fixed veterinary specimen
observations.anatomy: The nose forms a broad, approximately oval rooting surface at the snout tip. Two nares open onto that terminal surface.

landmarks.root: Continuous soft-tissue junction at the far end of the muzzle.
landmarks.extent: Forward-facing pad, full peripheral rim and paired nares.
landmarks.profile: Transversely broad shallow pad with rounded lateral corners and a relatively steep shoulder at its margin.

inference.geometry: A single oval terminal pad blends into a compact proximal collar. The paired blind recesses record the visible openings.
inference.missing_evidence: Verify rim projection and nostril orientation on calibrated side and frontal views of the same living animal. Fixed tissue and close perspective can alter the apparent outline. Airway continuation and pad deformation are unverified.

observations.anatomy: A single ventral mammary body is suspended between the hind legs. Four downward-projecting teats are in two longitudinal pairs.

landmarks.root: Broad lower caudal abdomen between the thighs.
landmarks.extent: Four separate blunt teat ends that project below the gland body.
landmarks.profile: A broad soft mass with a shallow rear median cleft and four spaced ventral exits.

inference.geometry: One fused gland body with a recessed midline and each teat fused into its ventral base.
inference.missing_evidence: Match calibrated side and rear views of one cow to resolve the upper attachment shape, fore/hind quarter proportions and effects of lactation or breed. Hind legs and fore udder continuity are partly obscured in the current views.

observations.anatomy: A single fleshy comb rises along the crown from near the beak and carries an irregular row of points and a rear blade.

landmarks.root: Longitudinal midline seat from the upper beak region over the crown.
landmarks.extent: Five raked rounded peaks in the modeled phenotype, then a low rear blade.
landmarks.profile: Continuous thin upright sheet with variable depth and a soft free rear end.

inference.geometry: One crown-seat mesh, caliper-like skin thickness, and a height/cant variation for the free portion.
inference.missing_evidence: Measure comb crest and seat in independent orthogonal views of one specified breed. Thickness, small surface bumps and natural flop during movement are unverified.

observations.anatomy: Two fleshy skin lobes are attached below the beak and hang from the sides of the lower-jaw region.

landmarks.root: Two proximal seats on either side beneath the beak.
landmarks.extent: Two rounded pendant margins separated by a visible median cleft.
landmarks.profile: Broad shallow overlapping shapes in profile, narrow lobes and central gap from the front.

inference.geometry: Two mirrored continuous lenticular lobes with paired upper seats and independent distal margins. Drop and splay are static shape controls.
inference.missing_evidence: Acquire a straight-on specimen view with both root lines and a calibrated side view. Jaw-open behavior, gravity-driven asymmetry and thickness are inferred.

observations.anatomy: The beagle foreface carries a moderate nasofrontal stop into a nearly straight, full muzzle with a squared-off nose and comparatively taut closed lips.

landmarks.root: Nasofrontal transition and rear cheeks, behind and below the bridge
landmarks.extent: Blunt leathered nose pad above the frontal lip line
landmarks.profile: Moderate stop, long low dorsal bridge and continuous lateral closed-mouth line

inference.geometry: A closed rostral shell with a shaped commissure and a seated nostril-bearing rhinarium.
inference.missing_evidence: Nose leather, nostril floor and oral depth are stylized. Closed-mouth only. A registered side silhouette and another measured frontal specimen remain pending.

observations.anatomy: The beagle ear has a low lateral attachment and drops beside the cheek. It widens into a long thin flap with a rounded tip and a leading edge turned slightly toward the cheek.

landmarks.root: Low lateral ear seat behind the orbit
landmarks.extent: Rounded end hangs near or below the lower jaw line
landmarks.profile: Shallow lateral rollover becomes a broad skin-covered sheet with the anterior edge tucked toward the cheek

inference.geometry: One closed variable-thickness cartilage sheet with a proximal roll and a shallow asymmetrical cup.
inference.missing_evidence: The hidden auricular concha, underside thickness and exact basal fold remain inferred. The available photographs show a static drape. Dynamic ear carriage remains pending.

observations.anatomy: Mystacial vibrissae emerge in staggered fields on two short convex surfaces immediately lateral and caudoventral to the nose.

landmarks.root: Bilateral upper lip and rostral cheek below and beside the nose leather
landmarks.extent: Outer caudolateral boundary of each whisker-bearing pad
landmarks.profile: Two rounded mounds separated by a shallow midline furrow, with several slanted rows of emergence points

inference.geometry: A shallow continuous surface with paired lobe relief and simplified visible follicle dimples. Separate whiskers can be placed on top.
inference.missing_evidence: Exact follicle count, concealed lower pad contours and fur compression are undetermined. The photographs do not provide calibrated profile depth or active whisking movement.

observations.anatomy: The domestic rabbit has a long metatarsal segment and four hind toes. In periscoping the foot is low against the substrate. Fur covers the plantar surface.

landmarks.root: Narrow ankle seat over the tarsal/heel transition
landmarks.extent: Four low toes at the distal end of the long foot, inner toe terminal reach shorter than that of the central pair
landmarks.profile: Low posterior heel and long metatarsal keel with small toe separations at the front

inference.geometry: One closed skin from ankle cuff through the metatarsus to four contiguous toes with shallow commissures. Claws and plantar fur are omitted from the clay part.
inference.missing_evidence: The skeletal views support segment proportions and toe count. True soft-tissue cross-sections, interdigital depths, sole shape under load and toe motion remain unmeasured.

proposals.name: Sea star radial arm core
proposals.discriminator: Discrete arms continue out of a central disc and flex individually instead of pulsing a continuous bell margin.
proposals.next_review: Get a scale-bearing oral and aboral pair to measure arm taper, disc diameter and cross-section.

proposals.name: Ambulacral tube feet
proposals.discriminator: A long extensible stalk ends in an adhesive pad; the pad is carried above the substrate rather than seated directly on an arm.
proposals.next_review: Compare loaded and retracted feet in a side macro for length and pad proportions.

proposals.name: Sea star spine-base pedicellariae
proposals.discriminator: Small cleaning jaws cluster against surface spines with no supporting hand or large limb.
proposals.next_review: Measure the jaws under magnification and determine a useful minimum rendered size.

proposals.name: Sea urchin test
proposals.discriminator: A fused radially organized body enclosure places foot pores in meridional bands.
proposals.next_review: Find taxon-specific meridional and polar views to establish plate boundaries and profile.

proposals.name: Radial sea urchin spines
proposals.discriminator: Spines cover the test and assist locomotion; they are individually supported around the body.
proposals.next_review: Inspect pivot bases and spine-length variation across the oral and aboral hemispheres.

proposals.name: Aristotle’s lantern tooth tips
proposals.discriminator: Five hard elements work around one oral opening, requiring radial closure.
proposals.next_review: Check open and closed oral specimen diagrams to establish which elements are exterior.

proposals.name: Chiton overlapping dorsal valves
proposals.discriminator: Longitudinally overlapping dorsal valves are embedded in a peripheral girdle and can change alignment.
proposals.next_review: Compare a common exposed-plate chiton in straight and curved profile views.

proposals.name: Broad creeping pedal sole
proposals.discriminator: The creeping sole is a continuous ventral muscular field, with no digits or limb end.
proposals.next_review: Document an underside view for sole-to-body width and the turn-up at its ends.

proposals.name: Coiled chambered shell
proposals.discriminator: A coiled enclosure terminates in a large aperture for the animal; the underlying curvature and entrance differ from a dome overlay.
proposals.next_review: Compare lateral and frontal shell views for whorl spacing and aperture aspect ratio.

proposals.name: Nautilus aperture hood
proposals.discriminator: A retractable head cover meets the rim of a second part and must change position relative to that shell.
proposals.next_review: Compare emerged and closed animals in matching frontal and lateral photographs.

proposals.name: Nautilus retractile tentacles
proposals.discriminator: Multiple slender, suckerless appendages emerge near the mouth with distinct basal organization.
proposals.next_review: Verify the arrangement of tentacle sheaths with an anterior anatomical plate.

proposals.name: Seahorse coronet
proposals.discriminator: One high compact cranial column ends in a knob or crown; the closest crest is a longitudinal ridge.
proposals.next_review: Compare side and front views across seahorse species for base width and crown variation.

proposals.name: Tubular seahorse snout
proposals.discriminator: The slender tube ends in a small terminal opening at the end of a narrow facial projection.
proposals.next_review: Collect lateral profiles of two more seahorse species and an open-mouth frame.

proposals.name: Coiling prehensile tail
proposals.discriminator: Grip requires multi-turn distal wrapping and contact around a host rather than a single balancing bend.
proposals.next_review: Review two holdfast diameters and free-swimming tail shape on a scale-bearing sequence.

proposals.name: Ray cephalic feeding lobes
proposals.discriminator: Head-adjacent lobes change between a rolled shape and an open food-guiding pair at the front of the head.
proposals.next_review: Find front and dorsal feeding images to measure rolled and open landmarks.

proposals.name: Ray pectoral disc
proposals.discriminator: The pectoral root extends into the whole lateral body outline; shaping the core is necessary to eliminate the short-root seam.
proposals.next_review: Measure root run and cross-sections from dorsal and lateral specimen views.

proposals.name: Broad monotreme sensory bill
proposals.discriminator: A broad bill ends in a blunt soft profile with nostrils set into its top rather than a cutting hook.
proposals.next_review: Find top and side images with a scale and check the soft bill-skull transition.

proposals.name: Overhanging swimming web
proposals.discriminator: Forefoot web lies beyond broad nails in swimming, giving the web an independent distal edge.
proposals.next_review: Confirm extension and land-fold poses in the same specimen or sequence.

proposals.name: Flattened mammal paddle tail
proposals.discriminator: A wide flattened mobile lobe can be modeled with a controllable aspect ratio and no fork.
proposals.next_review: Measure cross-sections along the tail to test compatibility with the flexible-tail family.

proposals.name: Imbricated mammal scale armor
proposals.discriminator: Repeating plate scales overlap across both surfaces and rim transitions, unlike sparse independent upright plates.
proposals.next_review: Record the armor boundary and overlap direction at shoulder, trunk and tail on specimen images.

proposals.name: Veiled chameleon casque
proposals.discriminator: A tall continuous head-local helmet suggests a profile control; the fit at the forehead remains to be checked.
proposals.next_review: Measure male and female head profiles and verify dorsal width.

proposals.name: Gular cone row
proposals.discriminator: A row of cones has the already supported serial ridge arrangement with a ventral root.
proposals.next_review: Review side and ventral views for row length and root direction.

proposals.name: Scuteless softshell turtle disc
proposals.discriminator: Dorsal covering is leathery and lacks scutes; a flattened shell profile and optional surface details may cover it.
proposals.next_review: Compare unscaled and calibrated side profiles to decide if the generic shell outline is sufficient.

proposals.name: Softshell turtle anterior tubercle rim
proposals.discriminator: The low projections follow a crescent along an existing shell edge and are too local to count as another shell family.
proposals.next_review: Measure the tubercle spacing from a dorsal reference and assess visibility at working clay scale.

proposals.name: Horned lizard paired lateral spike rows
proposals.discriminator: Existing ridge repetition can be placed on the sides as paired rows if their surface fit allows it.
proposals.next_review: Check lateral angle and row placement with frontal and side museum views.

proposals.name: Folded stomatopod club limb
proposals.discriminator: The folding prey-strike limb terminates in a club and has no closing chela.
proposals.next_review: Compare retracted and extended views to locate the distal flexion axis.

proposals.name: Crustacean telson and uropod fan
proposals.discriminator: A central terminal plate is flanked by coordinated rigid lobes, without discrete feather shafts.
proposals.next_review: Verify the lobe count and compare a spread tail and resting tail in dorsal views.

proposals.name: Serial abdominal swimmerets
proposals.discriminator: Repeated paired ventral paddles are rooted segment-by-segment, with a stroke needing phased local articulation.
proposals.next_review: Acquire a ventral image and walking/swimming sequence to resolve paddle contour and angle.

proposals.name: Centipede serial walking-leg field
proposals.discriminator: Segment-specific repeated placement adds evidence for the existing jointed arthropod limb.
proposals.next_review: Record phase and leg-length changes between anterior, middle and posterior segments.

proposals.name: Centipede forcipules
proposals.discriminator: The anterior prey-catching pair have a modified leg root behind the head and hook-like terminal segments.
proposals.next_review: Confirm hinge locations in ventral microscopy or an authored anatomical drawing.

proposals.name: Modified centipede ultimate legs
proposals.discriminator: The rear pair can use the generic arthropod limb with a separate decorative spination treatment.
proposals.next_review: Compare defensive pose with ordinary stepping to verify whether a new kinematic constraint is needed.

proposals.name: Odonate nymph prehensile labium
proposals.discriminator: A central fold-out plate with opposed tip palps combines forward extension and closing motion.
proposals.next_review: Acquire resting and extended microscopy from the side and underside.

proposals.name: Opposed cephalic and thoracic beetle horns
proposals.discriminator: Two horns face one another on different body segments; meaningful closure depends on the neck joint between their roots.
proposals.next_review: Confirm neck pivot and minimum horn clearance with lateral male specimen photographs.

proposals.name: Lamellate antenna club
proposals.discriminator: Small terminal plates can extend a segmented antenna shape without adding a separate base stalk.
proposals.next_review: Measure club lobe count and plate spread across multiple scarab species.

proposals.name: Sea spider oviger appendages
proposals.discriminator: These appendages are a dedicated anterior paired support for grooming and brooding, attached outside the feeding center.
proposals.next_review: Choose one species with ovigers and obtain a labeled lateral plate specifying the joint count.

proposals.name: Bat echolocation noseleaf
proposals.discriminator: A nasal plate surrounds the apertures and projects up as a separate thin flap.
proposals.next_review: Measure the blade and base separately in front and side for two phyllostomid taxa.

proposals.name: Myotis interfemoral membrane
proposals.discriminator: The independently authored bat tail membrane already covers the relevant attachment architecture.
proposals.next_review: Get a scale-bearing fully spread specimen view to compare membrane extent and trailing edge.

proposals.name: Humpback serrated flukes
proposals.discriminator: A species-specific pointed swept outline and serrated edge can fit the horizontal paired fluke construction.
proposals.next_review: Measure comparable dorsal images for notch depth, sweep, chord, and serration spacing.

proposals.name: Baleen filter racks
proposals.discriminator: Paired arrays of hanging filter plates form a continuous curtain inside the mouth.
proposals.next_review: Study a museum rack and open-mouth view to resolve plate taper and row arc, recording the visibility threshold.

proposals.name: Bottlenose rostral gape profile
proposals.discriminator: The pilot dolphin gape covers the short thick rostrum profile and should receive species-specific dimensions.
proposals.next_review: Acquire a side view at rest and open gape to resolve the commissure and relative jaw widths.

proposals.name: Pelican lower-bill scoop pouch
proposals.discriminator: The expandable skin is hosted along the elongated lower bill and opens as a scoop spanning the jaw branches.
proposals.next_review: Compare resting and loaded bill side views along with a frontal open profile.

proposals.name: Penguin swimming flipper
proposals.discriminator: The swimming wing has a compact foil profile and does not deploy slotted outer primaries.
proposals.next_review: Measure complete front/side and underwater spread poses to set the airfoil section and allowable flex.

proposals.name: Salamander external gill plume
proposals.discriminator: A projecting branched plume array requires separate geometry from recessed slit apertures.
proposals.next_review: Verify stalk count, rake, and secondary filament scale in frontal and lateral macro views.

proposals.name: Continuous salamander axial fin
proposals.discriminator: A soft median sheet follows the taper and movement of the axial tail instead of occupying one fixed dorsal patch.
proposals.next_review: Collect lateral images of straight and bent tails, retaining the boundary with the trunk.

proposals.name: Stellate sensory finger tips
proposals.discriminator: Each unwebbed fore-digit terminates in a radiating structure requiring more than a tapered finger tip.
proposals.next_review: Verify the morphology at macro scale and assess when the terminal lobes are visible.

proposals.name: Annelid terminal holdfast discs
proposals.discriminator: One broad disc at each end must serve as an alternating body support; repeated ventral arm cups operate differently.
proposals.next_review: Get contracted and extended side views and a ventral view of each disc opening.

proposals.name: Comb-jelly ciliary tracks
proposals.discriminator: The comb plates are repeated along multiple short surface tracks with a coordinated wave rather than one ridge.
proposals.next_review: Compare rows and their ends in a named species using photographs and microscopy.

proposals.name: Comb-jelly oral feeding lobes
proposals.discriminator: The appendages are expandable broad lobes flanking the oral region instead of hanging rope-like arms.
proposals.next_review: Use two views of a named lobate species to resolve the opening arc and root thickness.

proposals.name: Bryozoan ciliated lophophore
proposals.discriminator: The tentacle crown encircles each zooid's feeding aperture and retracts into its own housing.
proposals.next_review: Select a species with oral and lateral microscopy, and resolve crown diameter relative to zooid depth.

proposals.name: Sawfish toothed rostrum
proposals.discriminator: Rows of hard points grow out of a single flat rostrum, outside and ahead of the actual mouth.
proposals.next_review: Collect calibrated dorsal and side views and compare the proximal and distal tooth spacing.

proposals.name: Osprey reversible outer toe and pads
proposals.discriminator: The specialized grip uses an extra opposing configuration and textured support pads; it shares the raptor foot and claw framework.
proposals.next_review: Compare gripping and walking specimens for outer-toe range and sole shape.

proposals.name: African elephant trunk tip lobes
proposals.discriminator: Short opposing tip lobes support precision grasping without replacing the elongated flexible trunk.
proposals.next_review: Compare African and Asian elephant trunk tip photographs from the same angles.

proposals.name: African elephant incisor tusk
proposals.discriminator: The upper incisor root and long outward curve can be covered by the existing tusk profile.
proposals.next_review: Inspect lateral and frontal skull references to establish geometry of the insertion and tip sweep.

proposals.name: Leatherback longitudinal shell ridges
proposals.discriminator: Several lengthwise ridges alter the hull profile over an unsutured-looking surface and converge into a tapered rear.
proposals.next_review: Compare multiple dorsal views to account for tabulation differences in outer ridge counts.

proposals.name: Mussel external mantle lure
proposals.discriminator: The lure has a deployable soft silhouette that extends from a shell mantle opening and resembles an independent small fish.
proposals.next_review: Study emergence and display sequences for the deployment axis and specimen sidedness.

proposals.name: Horseshoe crab righting telson
proposals.discriminator: One rigid rod rotates about a posterior root while the nearest family has distributed bending along a segmented chain.
proposals.next_review: Measure lateral extent and root articulation in a righting sequence.

proposals.name: Digit-supported bat wing and free thumb
proposals.discriminator: Spar organization and an exposed leading-edge thumb are covered by the bat flight wing pilot.
proposals.next_review: Check two wing poses for attachment continuity and free thumb silhouette.

proposals.name: Cetacean dorsal blowhole aperture
proposals.discriminator: The near-flush opening is placed in the skull roof with closure through the surrounding tissue.
proposals.next_review: Check opening outline in an overhead view and measure opening and resting forms.

proposals.name: Rib-supported gliding patagium
proposals.discriminator: The paired lateral membranes attach to elongated thoracic ribs and couple to forelimbs at the leading edge during flight.
proposals.next_review: Read resting and glide contours in dorsal and lateral views, retaining the forelimb contact points.

proposals.name: Long-based sailfish first dorsal
proposals.discriminator: The separate height and host-root length span most of the back with a deployable silhouette.
proposals.next_review: Compare erected and folded profiles for coverage along the dorsal root.

proposals.name: Fused pelvic-fin adhesive disc
proposals.discriminator: The fins join in the centre to form a ventral holdfast with a shared distal rim.
proposals.next_review: Choose a species and verify ventral and lateral contours in attached and free poses.

proposals.name: Articulated anglerfish lure
proposals.discriminator: A median stalk on the face presents a conspicuous soft lure to prey using pivot and flexion.
proposals.next_review: Confirm origin and lure profile using a labeled specimen and deployed video.

proposals.name: Treefrog terminal toe pads
proposals.discriminator: One expanded mucus adhesive disc forms at each digit end without a shared central pad field.
proposals.next_review: Use underside images during grip and launch to measure pad width and toe flexion.

proposals.name: Little brown bat hindfoot proportion
proposals.discriminator: This species offers dimensional context for the pilot's hindfoot, without a distinct change in the construction.
proposals.next_review: Verify toe proportions and claw shape from original specimen drawings or ventral photographs.

proposals.name: Retractile tubeworm radiolar crown
proposals.discriminator: Feather-like filaments form a branching ring around the anterior end of a worm and retract into a cylindrical tube.
proposals.next_review: Select a species and get side-on and axial evidence showing the same deployed crown.

proposals.name: Bottlenose falcate dorsal fin
proposals.discriminator: The broad rooted, recurved single fin matches the specialized pilot profile.
proposals.next_review: Measure two ecotypes in side view to distinguish the usable range from variation across individuals.

proposals.name: Lamellar climbing digit
proposals.discriminator: Repeated lamellae under the digit provide a longitudinal contact surface that can peel. The anuran draft provides a single enlarged terminal contact instead.
proposals.next_review: Toe scales are sculpted as relief. Adhesive force, exact release path and tip attachment across foot types require study.

proposals.name: Opposed toe bundles
proposals.discriminator: Two opposing toe bundles act as broad grip faces with shared movement within each bundle.
proposals.next_review: The source shows grip on one branch. Two-diameter seating, actual contact and mounted handedness remain to be measured.

proposals.name: Interlocking caudal rattle
proposals.discriminator: Loose interlocking hollow segments hang from the tail tip with exposed gaps for limited independent movement.
proposals.next_review: Hollow wall thickness, captive joint play and sound are inferred. The exported nested pose does not establish dynamics.

proposals.name: Hinged plastral lobe
proposals.discriminator: An underside lobe rotates across a transverse plastral hinge and meets the edge of a fixed dorsal shell.
proposals.next_review: Slider poses approximate the hinge. Closed rim fit and exact full live rotation are pending.

proposals.name: Flattened leaf tail
proposals.discriminator: An asymmetric expanded tail forms a broad flattened leaf outline with irregular edge cutouts and almost no projecting axial ridge.
proposals.next_review: The oblique photo supports the dorsal shape. A calibrated lateral thickness and seated bend check are still needed.

proposals.name: Burrowing forefoot
proposals.discriminator: A broad, outward-facing digging hand with a widened medial edge is missing. Longer claws on an existing hand do not provide the same soil-contact silhouette.
proposals.next_review: The article text supports the macroscopic anatomy. Direct image comparison of the supplementary video and independently measured claw-to-palm ratios are pending. The pose control is roll at the local attachment. Coordinated shoulder and wrist kinematics are outside this mesh.

proposals.name: Ground braced tail
proposals.discriminator: A broad proximal tail can form a load path from a pelvic root to a long grounded segment while both hindfeet lift. A free tail chain has no stable support surface.
proposals.next_review: The lateral walking view supports the sagittal profile. Transverse flattening and exact contact pressure are inferred. The brace control gives static endpoints. No timing or force simulation is claimed.

proposals.name: Nail rim cushion foot
proposals.discriminator: A deep continuous plantar cushion supports a broad foot under a columnar limb, with discrete nails inserted into the perimeter wall. Neither a hard hoof capsule nor discrete pads captures the shared cushion-to-wall interface.
proposals.next_review: Nail count varies. Three seats represent the cited hindfoot condition. Reference captions and anatomy text were inspected. Nail orientation and exact transverse profile still require registered comparisons. The spread control is a sculpting variation, without validated compliance.

proposals.name: Splayed two toe sole
proposals.discriminator: Two large toe-bearing lobes share a broad soft sole with a distal cleft and separate dorsal nails. Under stance the lobes can diverge while the proximal pad remains continuous.
proposals.next_review: The source describes internal pads on either side of a septum. The shared exterior heel skin is modeled as one mesh. Source captions and anatomy text were inspected. A synchronized side and plantar loaded-to-lifted pair has not been calibrated. The splay control changes shape across two geometric endpoints without a tissue model.

proposals.name: Offset two toe running foot
proposals.discriminator: A large central support toe has a full longitudinal contact strip, with a shorter lateral toe making a separate off-axis contact. The toes have separate sole cushions and do not form a hard paired hoof.
proposals.next_review: The sole tread and small cornified papillae are omitted at fixture scale. Reference figure captions and anatomy text were inspected. Matched body loads and stride timing remain pending.

proposals.name: Leading edge alula hinge
proposals.discriminator: A digit-rooted feather cluster can lift ahead of the main leading edge and create a narrow gap independently of the primary feather fan. Its local pivot precedes the wrist-tip feather hinge.
proposals.next_review: The cited work describes the broader avian range of two to six feathers. Four vanes are a draft, not a counted specimen reconstruction. Exact hinge axis direction and distal profile need registered dorsal and edge-on specimen views. Operating poses are static geometry. The aerodynamic field is outside this fixture.

proposals.name: Compound ventral suction disc
proposals.discriminator: The adhesive footprint includes anterior and posterior regions formed at the pectoral and pelvic bases. Their extended rim and papilla fields require different seating from the goby pelvic-only rim.
proposals.next_review: Papilla density and crown relief are simplified. Released rim and pressure response are inferred.

proposals.name: Serial caudal finlets
proposals.discriminator: Short repeatable, independently rooted fins form dorsal and ventral rows separated by exposed skin. A common placement and angle rig must preserve the gaps and diminishing footprint.
proposals.next_review: Both banks use eight finlets within the reported range. Depth, decreasing projected heights and hinge angles are draft estimates.

proposals.name: Segmented spinelet dorsal
proposals.discriminator: Each serial module carries its own leading spine and trailing membrane. A folding row must preserve the individual spine-to-web boundary and seat each base independently.
proposals.next_review: Articular canal and bifid spine tip are omitted. The degree of neighbor attachment and fold profile need a clearer specimen pose.

proposals.name: Pelvic shield spine pair
proposals.discriminator: Long pelvic spines seat on opposite sides of a shared ventral girdle plate. Each can clear the belly when erected, with its own seat and pivot.
proposals.next_review: Shield cross-section and joint clearances are inferred. Spine thickness and tooth spacing are approximate. This is a rigid skeletal study.

proposals.name: Paired caudal peduncle keels
proposals.discriminator: Thin longitudinal keels project from the lateral walls of the tail stalk. The paired bases taper into the peduncle immediately before the tail, with negligible spanwise movement at the root.
proposals.next_review: Accessory offsets and transverse rake are inferred from qualitative sources. No species-matched measured cross-section.

proposals.name: Terminal clavus
proposals.discriminator: A deep rear fan attaches across the blunt trunk margin and joins the ends of the dorsal and anal regions. The wide posterior seat replaces a narrow terminal peduncle root.
proposals.next_review: Skin/ossicle distinction is represented as coarse external relief. Deflection range and hidden section remain inferred.

proposals.name: Distal tentacle club
proposals.discriminator: A narrow strike stalk carries a flattened, expanded distal grip club with discrete sucker zones on one face.
proposals.next_review: Section depths and absolute dimensions are inferred. Species-matched oral and edge views and a local prey-capture pose remain open. Four rows show representative cups. Fine teeth, protective membranes and trabeculae are out of scope.

proposals.name: Mantle ribbon fin
proposals.discriminator: A narrow fin ribbon has a long continuous mantle seam and a free edge that can carry a traveling bend along one side.
proposals.next_review: Fin-wave phase is a static geometry control. Ray-free thickness, wave amplitude, wavelength and local root curvature are inferred. Recorded phase progression and measured outline comparison remain open.

proposals.name: Hinged bivalve valves
proposals.discriminator: Two cupped valves face one another and rotate around a shared dorsal line, with an opposing closure rim and hinge ears.
proposals.next_review: Pose control rotates around an inferred transverse line. Hinge ligament, mantle body and finer growth sculpture are out of scope. Seam interlock and live gape under load await corresponding reference and local fixture.

proposals.name: Fused double siphon
proposals.discriminator: A common extensible sheath encloses two externally visible apertures with distinct rim contours separated by a bridge.
proposals.next_review: The channels end as shallow exterior recesses. Internal organs and hydraulics are out of scope. Reference samples are from different poses or specimens. Extension and bend calibration are open.

proposals.name: Retractile lamellate rhinophore
proposals.discriminator: An upright stalk has overlapping transverse lamellae and retracts into a dedicated dorsal pocket rim.
proposals.next_review: Relative diameter and sheath wall depth are inferred. Shortening control approximates the visible withdrawn state and does not simulate soft tissues. Calibrated matched retraction views are pending.

proposals.name: Biramous chaetal parapodium
proposals.discriminator: One lateral fleshy mount divides into two rami ending in separated chaetal fans, with clear spaces between both contact rows.
proposals.next_review: Depth of the two fleshy branches, bristle-count simplification and fitted orientation are inferred. Internal aciculae are excluded. Same-specimen three-quarter outline and live loaded locomotor sweep remain open.

proposals.name: Coiling siphoning proboscis
proposals.discriminator: The paired galeae join into one flexible conduit that stores in a compact planar coil and straightens from its facial seat.
proposals.next_review: Paired external seam is coarse. The model preserves approximately the centerline length through authored poses. Hidden contact surfaces and natural curvature progression were not measured.

proposals.name: Opposed spined foreleg
proposals.discriminator: A broadened spined femur and hinged spined tibia fold into an opposed clamp, carried on an elongated coxa.
proposals.next_review: The model represents gross spine rows and an authored flexion arc. Tooth counts, hinge limits, spine clearance against a specimen and detailed distal joints remain unverified.

proposals.name: Fossorial tibial shovel
proposals.discriminator: A broad toothed tibial shovel seats beside a small articulated tarsus, creating a rigid soil-contact edge proximal to the foot.
proposals.next_review: Single projected macro supports margins and the tarsal offset. Thickness, exact taper and tarsal flexion are authored. The tip orientation is local and the specimen’s absolute scale is unavailable.

proposals.name: Clubbed halter balance organ
proposals.discriminator: A short narrow stalk with a terminal club oscillates at a small basal joint behind the flight wing.
proposals.next_review: Default rod/club dimensions and travel are inferred. The Musca macro obscures the root and does not support a measured range.

proposals.name: Bipectinate sensory antenna
proposals.discriminator: Paired lateral rami arise along successive flagellar segments and taper toward both ends, forming a two-sided comb on a continuous shaft.
proposals.next_review: The authored approximate basket angle and branch count are not measured from the WT-M projection. No individual sensilla or internal segments are modeled.

proposals.name: Hooked soft abdominal proleg
proposals.discriminator: A compressible unsegmented abdominal lobe terminates in a soft pad with a curved row of fine hooks at its edge.
proposals.next_review: Schematic external landmarks informed a coarse flexible lobe. Crochet count, soft-tissue response and actual load-dependent grip were not measured.

proposals.name: Traveling wave anal ribbon
proposals.discriminator: A long, ventral anal ribbon sends an alternating wave along a continuous root while the trunk remains comparatively stable. The repeated ray stations and a controlled phase direction define the motion.
proposals.next_review: This is a local excerpt with 32 coarse visible ray bands. Direction follows increasing or decreasing phase. No observed speed, phase speed or signed force is imposed.

proposals.name: Ray fan with ventral sword
proposals.discriminator: A rounded ray fan has a ventral bundle that extends as a narrow sword. The bundle emerges from rays shared with the ventral fan rather than forming a second foil lobe.
proposals.next_review: Ray branching and segment sutures are simplified. Available specimen references do not calibrate 3D camber.

proposals.name: Lobed fin with distal ray fan
proposals.discriminator: A thick fleshy proximal lobe has a movable distal transition into a fin-ray fan. The lobe, distal flex axis and terminal fan require distinct sections and articulation.
proposals.next_review: The flex axis and solid skin thickness are inferred. Full-fold lobe-to-web overlap and trunk clearance require fit review.

proposals.name: Detached pectoral walking rays
proposals.discriminator: The lowest pectoral rays are free, separately anchored and mobile below the main fin. Their attachment and stance must coexist with the intact webbed fin above.
proposals.next_review: The main web is a local proxy. Distal taste papillae and contact-scale kinematics are omitted.

proposals.name: Perforated shell vent row
proposals.discriminator: A single curvature-matched shell band carries a row of through-holes with raised collars and a sequence of closed former openings.
proposals.next_review: Uniform sector thickness and two sealed-site profiles are simplified. No fitted whole shell or living tissue is modeled. No measured pore spacing and matched silhouette are available.

proposals.name: Stalked tube operculum
proposals.discriminator: A funnel-shaped stopper is carried on an elongate flexible stalk at the crown base and seats against the protective tube opening during withdrawal.
proposals.next_review: The model supports independent stopper width and stalk length. No actual time-dependent retraction is implemented. The sculpt is intentionally scale-adjustable. The published reference across the stopper is about 4 mm, whereas the default modeled rim is larger. Stopping position and contact with a measured tube rim remain unverified.

proposals.name: Bifid proboscis gutter
proposals.discriminator: A flat ribbon splits into two broad distal lobes while a continuous exposed collecting gutter leads back toward the mouth.
proposals.next_review: The model depicts exterior shape and grooves only. Groove depths and outstretched live pose are inferred from preserved images and descriptions. The local substrate contact path is untested.

proposals.name: Septate coral polyp cup
proposals.discriminator: A rigid cup carries radial septa projecting inward from its wall and supports a retracting soft polyp by the full enclosing circumference.
proposals.next_review: The model simplifies septal relief into a small number of height levels. Distinct pali and fine columella structure remain unresolved. The polyp itself and its retraction are outside the rigid cup model.

proposals.name: Sheathed tentacle with tentilla
proposals.discriminator: A main retractable filament with repeated side branches leaves an individual body-side sheath aperture.
proposals.next_review: Only the external sheath collar and deployed tentacle segment are modeled. Internal sheath and tissue turnover are out of scope. Filament length and lateral-branch splay are inferred and simplified. The extension control does not show the full withdrawal mechanism.

proposals.name: Sand fringe digit
proposals.discriminator: Free lateral combs on individual toes increase contact width while the toe gaps stay open.
proposals.next_review: Exact counts, in-sand contact and mating clearance remain unmeasured.

proposals.name: Hindfoot excavation spade
proposals.discriminator: A hard cutting spade sits on the inner heel, leaving forward toes clear for traction.
proposals.next_review: The photograph does not supply physical scale or a loaded digging pose. Backwards substrate contact and neighboring digits are pending.

proposals.name: Ventral traction scute row
proposals.discriminator: Broad transverse belly scutes cover most of the contact width and overlap along the travel direction on an otherwise flexible body.
proposals.next_review: Cross-sectional thickness, root seating and friction are inferred. The photo substantiates external arrangement.

proposals.name: Raised trunk annuli
proposals.discriminator: Deep transverse skin furrows divide a continuous trunk into annuli without separate exposed hard plates.
proposals.next_review: Depth and annular count per unit length are stylized. Bend is an adjustable sculpt state, and real axial kinematics remain open.

proposals.name: Dorsal brood cell patch
proposals.discriminator: Individual recessed dorsal brood cells have soft raised rims lying in a continuous skin patch.
proposals.next_review: Cavity depth is design-inferred. Host curvature fit and mature empty-cell landmarks need independent review.

proposals.name: Opposed terminal forceps
proposals.discriminator: Two curved cerci articulate from separate abdominal sockets and oppose each other across the midline with two movable arms.
proposals.next_review: Modeled one large-cercus adult male form with approximate rest and spread angles. Individual asymmetry and mechanical loads are unverified.

proposals.name: Overhanging pronotal crown
proposals.discriminator: A rigid stalked crown rises from a small pronotal base and branches into free rounded terminals with large open spaces around the structure.
proposals.next_review: The crown omits fine setae and infers thickness and exact branch separation from projected views. Function of the ornament is unresolved.

proposals.name: Rigid eyestalk antenna crown
proposals.discriminator: A continuous rigid head projection carries both the terminal compound eye and an adjacent antennal socket on its distal expansion.
proposals.next_review: One side is authored. The posterior process depth, exact lens inset and antennal socket depth are inferred; individual eye facets and the antenna are outside the scope.

proposals.name: Stiff to membranous forewing
proposals.discriminator: A thickened basal forewing plate continues into a thin distal membrane with a visible transition and overlapping distal tips.
proposals.next_review: Thickness, curvature and raised-pose angle are authored. The apical venation is summarized by relief. Paired wing overlap, flex and specimen thickness are pending.

proposals.name: Folding pleonal apron
proposals.discriminator: A broad segmented pleon folds under the body, wrapping onto the sternum along a defined edge and opening on its posterior hinge.
proposals.next_review: Ventral macro constrains the closed contour only. Pose, thickness, seat overlap and segment count across partly hidden proximal regions remain authored approximations.

proposals.name: Pedal swimming wings
proposals.discriminator: Paired broad muscular lobes join the front of a shell-less body and flap through a short, fleshy root without a supporting ray skeleton.
proposals.next_review: Stroke and twist are independent static mesh controls. Root thickness and curvature are inferred. Matched local views from the same animal and a two-wing sweep remain pending.

proposals.name: Dendritic oral collecting tentacle
proposals.discriminator: A tree-branched soft oral tentacle spreads distal collection branches then folds them together as the stem bends toward the mouth.
proposals.next_review: Branch count and distribution are inferred from the silhouette of a whole crown. Folded fronds are supported by a pose control but not a recorded insertion sequence. Cilia and mucus are outside the geometry.

proposals.name: Crinoid pinnulate arm
proposals.discriminator: A jointed axis carries two rows of separately seated side pinnules with surface collecting grooves leading to the arm groove.
proposals.next_review: The draft is an arm sector, with approximate size and groove width. Pinnule joints, individual tube feet and tissue-layer detail are simplified or omitted. The bend control approximates gross curl without skeletal joint constraints.

proposals.name: Ophiuroid jointed arm
proposals.discriminator: An articulated side-bending arm carries repeating dorsal, ventral and lateral plates and separate lateral spine rows.
proposals.next_review: The sweep is a posed curve with independently seated hard surface islands. Dorsal and ventral armor outline, segment counts and spine axes remain simplified. The underlying articulating ossicles and oral tube feet are outside scope.

proposals.name: Surface float sail
proposals.discriminator: A buoyant elongate sac carries a continuous raised sail seam along its top and supports dependent attachments along the underside.
proposals.next_review: The model describes only the exterior float. Colony appendages and internal structure are excluded. Crest lean is a signed geometric control. Fluid buoyancy and wind response are outside the static attachment model. Waterline and ventral contact fixture checks are open.

proposals.name: Hinged gill cover
proposals.discriminator: A movable, overlapping gill cover with a free rear edge is missing. Slits and exposed gill plumes represent different structures.
proposals.next_review: Medial face, hinge axis, thickness, and pose angles are inferred. A cover and abstract describe pumping without a quantified open pose.

proposals.name: Bill edge filter
proposals.discriminator: Opposing comb-like lamellae integrated into the margins of a bill form a route between the jaw edges. Hanging racks of baleen and a hooked bill cover different forms.
proposals.next_review: Coarse repeated units exaggerate relief and omit deep submarginal fields. Material, filtration and live gait are not simulated. Near-closed interference still needs checking.

proposals.name: Annular suction mouth
proposals.discriminator: A complete annular lip carries concentric keratin tooth fields around a central oral opening, with separate marginal fimbriae along the attachment rim.
proposals.next_review: Tooth sectors and rim papillae are coarse approximations. The head-side depth is inferred and suction mechanics remain untested.

proposals.name: Crossed bill tips
proposals.discriminator: Upper and lower bill tips curve laterally past one another and create a crossing tip contact that changes under off-axis jaw motion.
proposals.next_review: Crossing side is baked into the modeled individual. Tip overlap, lower hinge excursion, and hidden palate surface are estimates.

proposals.name: Deployable feather crown
proposals.discriminator: A row of independently seated long crown feathers changes from a nested, rear-folded stack to an elevated curved fan, preserving overlap around the skull.
proposals.next_review: Actual feather count, basal quill positions and fully folded profile are inferred from limited views. The deployment control morphs authored feathers and does not bind them to an animated rig.

proposals.name: Rotating ocular turret
proposals.discriminator: A conical skin enclosure moves with most of the globe and leaves a small front aperture while the rounded base stays seated in the skull.
proposals.next_review: Smooth geometry omits lid scales. Hidden internal globe is integrated as a visible corneal proxy. Pose sweep and mechanism are stylized.

proposals.name: Lateral headfoil sensor seats
proposals.discriminator: A continuous flattened head crossbar blends into the cranium and houses eyes at both distal ends and olfactory openings along its leading edge.
proposals.next_review: Eye placement uses gross position only. Anterior channels are stylized and undercut seating was inferred. Reference is uncalibrated.

proposals.name: Immersed lower bill blade
proposals.discriminator: The laterally compressed lower blade extends well ahead of the upper bill and presents a long submerged cutting edge during a shallow open gape.
proposals.next_review: Depth beneath water and jaw opening angles are illustrative. Foil thickness and bill attachment were estimated from the profile.

proposals.name: Waterline split eye
proposals.discriminator: A single eye presents two separate pupil openings and air-facing and water-facing optical zones within one globe, registered to the habitual surface line.
proposals.next_review: Neutral clay uses aperture and split relief in place of pigmentation and transparency. Optical performance is deliberately outside scope.

proposals.name: Nasal tactile rosette
proposals.discriminator: Individually rooted fleshy rays form an annulus around two nostrils, with shorter central ray pairs forming a distinct forward sampling region.
proposals.next_review: Exact active reach of each ray and the microscopic Eimer organs are outside this draft. Ray curvature in the contact pose is inferred.

proposals.name: Paired dorsal nasal tubes
proposals.discriminator: Two forward-facing nasal passages sit side by side in a common raised dorsal bill housing, with a visible central partition and continuous base seam.
proposals.next_review: The photograph does not resolve separate bore depth or distal opening shape. The partition, double passage interior and airway depth are inferred.

proposals.name: Fused polygonal trunk armor
proposals.discriminator: Fused polygonal scutes form a faceted enclosure whose rigid corners run across dorsal and ventral panels. Fin openings interrupt the plates.
proposals.next_review: Scute variation and suture teeth are simplified. Geometric positions and aperture dimensions are inferred.

proposals.name: Five row bossed scutes
proposals.discriminator: Separate projecting bony scutes form one dorsal, two lateral and two ventrolateral rows, leaving substantial skin between rows. Root orientation differs at each row.
proposals.next_review: Microscopic alveoli are represented at coarse resolution. Variation in exact section, spacing and angle needs matched specimen sections.

proposals.name: Deployable ray fan wing
proposals.discriminator: Long segmented fin rays spread a collapsible membrane fan and close into a narrow flank-aligned bundle. The motion requires a ray fan at a compact fish fin root.
proposals.next_review: Ray branching, gliding camber and exact spread angle are inferred. The draft does not include neighboring pelvic fins.

proposals.name: Paired labellar sponge
proposals.discriminator: Two broad terminal lobes spread side by side from a hinged proboscis and present a channelled contact face to the substrate.
proposals.next_review: A flattened mount informs face-on proportions. Thickness, folding axis and the simplified channel relief are inferred. The geometry is a visual surface model.

proposals.name: Eversible forked osmeterium
proposals.discriminator: A forked soft organ emerges through a single dorsal slit behind the head and retracts into that seam, with both branches opening from a common base.
proposals.next_review: The deployed form is based on photographs. Stored volume, internal inversion and material response are inferred; the control represents a static range of visibility.

proposals.name: Clustered articulated spinnerets
proposals.discriminator: Several short silk-placement appendages occupy independent sockets around the abdominal tip and present a grouped placement surface.
proposals.next_review: Topological arrangement is supported. Coarse hinges, working orientation, unoccluded side profiles and exact scale are inferred. Individual silk spigots are omitted.

proposals.name: Hinged book gill stack
proposals.discriminator: Broad ventral appendage plates carry recessed stacks of overlapping leaf-like lamellae that move together as the plates hinge.
proposals.next_review: Twenty-one visible lamellae represent coarser than natural layer density. The ventilatory arc and adjacent stack clearance are unverified. Fine gas-exchange surfaces and setae are omitted.

proposals.name: Individually lobate swim toes
proposals.discriminator: Each toe carries its own elongate lobes with free lateral borders. Interdigital gaps remain open as the lobes turn edge-on on recovery and flare on the power stroke.
proposals.next_review: The coot illustrates the queue family, whose initial reference query lists great crested grebe. Coot joint constrictions are the chosen morphology. The source figure captions and discussion were inspected. An adult orthogonal specimen and underwater endpoints are pending. The common deploy control pairs distinct static orientations per ray. Continuous stroke and lobe clearances remain pending.

proposals.name: Totipalmate hallux swim web
proposals.discriminator: A rear or medial hallux joins the web extending to all three forward digits, giving the paddle a membrane anchored on both sides of the foot base. A fourth forward-fanned toe leaves out that connection.
proposals.next_review: Great cormorant illustrates the same topology named in the queue for double-crested cormorant. Figure captions and adult topology descriptions were inspected. Relative adult toe lengths and angles need an orthogonal adult specimen. The splay parameter rebuilds poses and web junctions. Hydrodynamics and recovery motion remain pending.

proposals.name: Multianchor glide membrane
proposals.discriminator: A continuous membrane terminates at all four limbs and extends along the tail, with anterior and lateral panels meeting at shared limb anchors. A wing and separate tail web leave discontinuities along those common boundaries.
proposals.next_review: The available gliding drawing is oblique. Registered dorsal/ventral photographs, individual digit webbing and calibrated anchor spans remain pending. The local draft omits hands and feet so that independent appendages can supply the digit margins. The spread control is a static envelope. Motion and matching anchor travel remain pending.

proposals.name: Covert train elevation
proposals.discriminator: The dominant fan is formed by extended upper coverts rising in front of a shorter rectrix support plane. The two groups attach at different levels and move together during elevation.
proposals.next_review: The modeled feather number is a coarse proxy. The source contains mature and immature displays with many more visible feathers. The clay model includes terminal width, without iridescence or color-pattern eyespots. Tail root contact and feather-on-feather mechanics require a local body fixture and related pose references.

proposals.name: Deployable water carrying feather
proposals.discriminator: Distinct inner and outer barb regions change arrangement when wet so adjacent barbules create a volume between overlapping filaments. It requires an explicit deployable lattice instead of a solid vane.
proposals.next_review: The mesh is an enlarged explanatory slice with sampled barbs. It has no inferred material properties or fluid model. The relative dimensions and wet-state geometry need matched microscope image registration. The dry and wet controls are static shape endpoints. Surface tension and water capacity were not evaluated.

proposals.name: Hoof frog heel assembly
proposals.discriminator: An inset V-shaped frog divides paired grooves and joins the rear heel buttresses inside the hollow sole. A rounded hoof or split count cannot encode an internal heel-to-sole support interface.
proposals.next_review: The illustrated solar topology supports the part. The draft does not resolve internal laminae, connective tissue, sole load distribution or a specimen-specific contour. An independently measured unshod specimen and floor plane contact assessment are pending.

proposals.name: Rolling trunk band armor
proposals.discriminator: Near-transverse trunk bands connect fixed shoulder and pelvic shells and change overlap over a compliant waist during closure. The relative motion is carried by paired curved seams at the ends of the flexible belt.
proposals.next_review: The rigid panels model envelope and seams, with surface tiles and ventral closure outside this draft. The paper uses one abnormal specimen. Only the reported normal side and independent species description informed the count. Inter-band clearance under rotation and contact between the curled end shields need a local swept fixture.

proposals.name: Suspensory hook manus
proposals.discriminator: An elongated narrow hand carries a close set of long hooks whose inner curves form the principal support against a branch. The proximal palm remains outside the branch-contact arc.
proposals.next_review: Paper photographs establish pose and contact context. A scale-bearing palmar view and ungual angle calibration remain pending. Static curling geometry omits tendon loading and skin compliance.

proposals.name: Spiny tail whorls
proposals.discriminator: Repeated rigid spine-bearing rings wrap a flexible tail while keeping the underside and inter-ring bends open.
proposals.next_review: Rear coverage, seated flexion and exact contact clearances need independent specimen views. The local bend is not modeled.

proposals.name: Flank spike fringe
proposals.discriminator: A narrow contour of short side-facing spikes follows the flank margin while leaving the dorsal armor and limb bases free.
proposals.next_review: The underside row and actual flank seam are partly obscured. A scaled side view, paired mount and limb clearance remain open.

proposals.name: Passive lateral glide fringe
proposals.discriminator: A shallow passive skin sheet follows the flank and limb margins without an extended rib fan.
proposals.next_review: The photo establishes the outline at rest. Deployed camber, fold angles and wing edge deformation remain design estimates.

proposals.name: Vascular flank filaments
proposals.discriminator: A dense skirt of simple filaments arises from the flank and hindlimb skin with distributed roots.
proposals.next_review: Detail geometry is stylized from a comparative illustration. Filament diameters, full host coverage and contact clearance remain unmeasured.

proposals.name: Radial acoustic face disc
proposals.discriminator: Shallow radial facial feather walls shape a broad acoustic funnel around the eyes and lead into recessed lateral ear entrances behind the ruff.
proposals.next_review: No held-out specimen section or matched side view. Acoustic effect, concealed ear geometry and feather number remain untested.

proposals.name: Bill supported hollow casque
proposals.discriminator: A roofed suprabill shell spans from forehead to proximal bill and joins the bill along a broad saddle, with a free raised edge and internal cavity.
proposals.next_review: Interior wall and density are inferred from the structure class. An open underside serves the swappable fixture. The biological air volume is not simulated.

proposals.name: Paired cervical display sacs
proposals.discriminator: Two anterior cervical membranes bulge through separate openings of a feathered collar, exposing a shared center divider and changing the display silhouette together.
proposals.next_review: The zero setting minimizes visible dome relief. Internal air-sac origin, precise rest folds, feather interactions and airflow have not been measured.

proposals.name: Ventral protrusible suction mouth
proposals.discriminator: A ventral, initially tucked mouth emerges below the rostrum on a short protrusible linkage with a flexible collar and a downward-facing lip opening.
proposals.next_review: The posed anatomical linkage, excursion and inner aperture are inferred. The physical model is limited to the exposed lip and collar, with no study-driven angle calibration.

proposals.name: Shell seated foreflipper
proposals.discriminator: A broad shoulder cuff seats within the shell's anterior notch and transitions into a long, flattened digit-supported blade. Its recovery stroke has a constrained passage along the shell lip.
proposals.next_review: Shoulder skin blending, digit scale creases and ground-state profile need a close living reference. Flex and stroke controls are qualitative.

proposals.name: Rotating hindflipper foot
proposals.discriminator: An ankle rotates a broad five-digit webbed paddle under the body for support and rearward for swimming. The outer rays frame the paddle as it changes both orientation and spread.
proposals.next_review: Live tarsal rotation and stance contact angles are inferred. The cuff is a local skin proxy, with separate moving web geometry.

proposals.name: Stalked camouflage blades
proposals.discriminator: Multiple decorative blades emerge on narrow stalks with individual roots distributed over flank and tail. Their leaf-like surfaces can remain distinct when the local host curves.
proposals.next_review: Blade count refers to the local coupon only. Exact angle, edge wear and flow response remain inferred.

proposals.name: External egg suspension stalks
proposals.discriminator: Short maternal stalks connect the ventral skin to individual carried eggs. Each unit must carry a terminal body while leaving exposed skin between stalks.
proposals.next_review: Egg and stalk dimensions are qualitative. Maternal tissue detail, ovum-stage change and vascular detail are omitted.

proposals.name: Expandable burrowing foot wedge
proposals.discriminator: An extensible compressed foot passes through the valve gap and expands distally into a broad sediment anchor.
proposals.next_review: Cross sections and absolute dimensions are inferred. Dilation and extension are independent static controls. The model covers the external foot only, without tissue anatomy or sediment simulation.

proposals.name: Foot carried shell operculum
proposals.discriminator: A foot-mounted rigid plate seats into a shell opening during withdrawal, with a shell aperture rim that constrains its path.
proposals.next_review: Withdrawal control rotates the plate around an inferred local foot axis. Exact shell-envelope contact and live closure remain unresolved. The foot proxy is limited to the attachment under the plate.

proposals.name: Segmented grasping cirrus
proposals.discriminator: A chain of discrete short segments curls from a compact cirrus socket and terminates in a hooked contact segment.
proposals.next_review: The small opposing process and exact root width require closer same-taxon views. Grip numerically changes a whole-chain arc and is not a simulation of individual live joint loading.

proposals.name: Subumbrella velarial shelf
proposals.discriminator: An inward-facing flexible shelf creates a smaller outlet inside a box-shaped bell rim and deforms as the bell pulses.
proposals.next_review: The muscle, canals and unseen cross sections are simplified. Static contraction and bias do not reproduce pressure, water flow or full directional variation. The bell rim is a fixture outside the isolated geometry.

proposals.name: Folded anterior pseudotentacles
proposals.discriminator: The two visible points are folds of one continuous anterior sheet margin, with the same margin forming their connecting valley.
proposals.next_review: The ventral profile and cross section are inferred. The part stops near the first unmodified body sheet seam. Pigmentation, eyespots and whole-body glide are outside scope.

proposals.name: Barrel osculum funnel
proposals.discriminator: A broad terminal rim opens down into a tapered surface cavity continuous with a thick vertical wall.
proposals.next_review: The collar is an open model sector; the deep chamber, microbial structures and rest of the sponge are excluded. Wall corrugation and thickness are inferred. Measured profile alignment remains pending.

proposals.name: Syndactyl grooming toes
proposals.discriminator: Two distinct claw tips sit on digits enclosed in a shared sleeve beside larger free toes. An array of independently rooted claws lacks the shared base and cleft between the tips.
proposals.next_review: The queue references a red-necked wallaby. The published right-foot specimen used here is a brush-tailed rock-wallaby. The adult skin surface and exact claw spacing remain estimated. Published skeletal and soft-tissue records establish topology. Only the paired unit is modeled. Adjacent load-bearing digits remain fixture objects.

proposals.name: Partially fused perching foot
proposals.discriminator: Two forward digits share a proximal sleeve while separate terminal segments bend around the perch. Toe strings with only a basal pivot cannot represent the joined length and distal break point.
proposals.next_review: Adult accession and calibrated view registration remain pending. The curl control adjusts geometry without a validated branch grasp or force model.

proposals.name: Bark bracing rectrix pair
proposals.discriminator: Stiff central rectrices project below the rump and terminate in a paired prop contact. Their overlapping neighbor feathers need clearance to follow the tail angle without taking over the main contact.
proposals.next_review: Comparative shaft data explains the geometry. Pileated rectrix widths and relative tip projection remain inferred without a spread specimen. Actual bending stiffness, bark pressure and contact remain pending.

proposals.name: Free climbing wing digits
proposals.discriminator: Two free clawed digits project from the juvenile wing hand and can wrap a branch while developing wing surfaces remain clear. A single free thumb or a continuous flight edge misses the two-digit reach and release.
proposals.next_review: The prenatal scan and nestling activity evidence fix gross topology. A scaled adult-style aerodynamic wing is outside scope. Feather emergence and exact claw-to-wrist dimensions remain inferred.

proposals.name: Ventral brooding drape
proposals.discriminator: A dependent abdominal fold drapes over an object on top of the feet to form a three-sided enclosure. Its opening and contact path depend on a separate floor formed by the pes.
proposals.next_review: The evidence establishes topology. A scale-bearing edge-on transfer image and exact object contact surface are unresolved. Skin fold stretch, heat transfer, and egg handling are outside the local static geometry.

proposals.name: Tadpole scraping oral disc
proposals.discriminator: A ventral disc carries successive transverse rows of small labial teeth and paired upper and lower keratin jaw sheaths inside marginal papillae.
proposals.next_review: Microscopic relief is deliberately coarsened. Exact papilla number and disc wall depth have not been measured. Explicitly premetamorphic.

proposals.name: Retractile chemosensory tentacle
proposals.discriminator: A short sensory tentacle extends and retracts into a defined facial canal between the eye region and nostril, leaving a slit-shaped remnant at rest.
proposals.next_review: The everted excursion, hidden sheath shape and motion curve are inferred. The source taxon was changed from the proposed ringed caecilian to Dermophis because its tentacular apparatus is directly illustrated.

proposals.name: Suspended thermal pit
proposals.discriminator: A loreal cavity opens behind and below the nostril with a suspended sensory membrane separating internal chambers.
proposals.next_review: Membrane depth, wall thickness and vent geometry are inferred. No sensing simulation or tissue model is included.

proposals.name: Gular palatal seal
proposals.discriminator: Opposing soft folds at the rear palate and tongue base form a seal across the pharynx while the front of the mouth can remain open.
proposals.next_review: Closure is parameterized and no pressure seal has been demonstrated. Soft-tissue deformation and velar chord are outside this isolated draft.

proposals.name: Cervical rib hood
proposals.discriminator: Paired extending neck ribs spread an enclosing cervical hood alongside an elongated neck.
proposals.next_review: Local +Y follows the upright neck. The regular sleeve and pose slider are modeling approximations. Actual rib timing, thickness, rotation and collar-to-neck fit remain unverified.

proposals.name: Radially folding hindwing
