proposals.discriminator: A ribbed wing fan collapses across radial and transverse fold lines into a short package behind its root.
proposals.next_review: Open and folded endpoint specimens inform a simplified static morph. The draft does not establish physical crease trajectories, coupled hinge motion or compact fit in the forewing covers.

proposals.name: Tibial basket pollen press
proposals.discriminator: A smooth exterior tibial basin sits inside a raised fringe and meets the expanded basitarsus at a visible loading joint.
proposals.next_review: The external basin, hair field and hinge are stylized at part scale. Exact press motion and pellet contact are unverified. Individual setal dimensions are simplified.

proposals.name: Latched ventral springfork
proposals.discriminator: A bifurcated abdominal lever folds forward along the underside into a ventral catch and swings backward as a single root-driven springfork.
proposals.next_review: Reference species informs the latch arrangement. External proportions are additionally informed by a congener and remain inferred. The hinge range is a static comparison and does not model latch release force or stored energy.

proposals.name: Folding rostral sheath
proposals.discriminator: A narrow multi-jointed labium folds back under the head and bends at its distal joints against the feeding surface, with a visible longitudinal groove.
proposals.next_review: The flexible hinge membranes and out-of-plane curvature are inferred. The model represents only the external labial cover and its coarse groove.

proposals.name: Closing ventral brood folds
proposals.discriminator: Two elongated belly folds flank the incubation surface and meet along a longitudinal closure. That seam and its recessed interior require two separately seated edges.
proposals.next_review: Per-embryo compartments and mucosal tissue are omitted. Exact flap thickness and the loaded-to-empty motion are inferred.

proposals.name: Solid axial swim paddle
proposals.discriminator: The tail broadens within the continuous, flattened solid core, with broad flanks and a compressed trailing edge. Cross-section and taper must produce a load-bearing paddle without flanges split off from the core.
proposals.next_review: Matched cross-sections and swimming bend angles are unavailable. Standard neutral geometry omits scale surfaces.

proposals.name: Pressure erectile dermal spine field
proposals.discriminator: Dermal spines rotate from a laid-back rest pose towards radial extension as the surrounding skin expands. Each spine needs an embedded base and a linked distribution over the deforming host.
proposals.next_review: This is a qualitative posture control. Specimen-specific skin mechanics, pressure and root attachments have not been fitted.

proposals.name: Paired to single caudal scute crest
proposals.discriminator: Paired raised dorsal scute rows transition into a single median scute row on the swimming tail. The geometry changes seating and count over one axial transition.
proposals.next_review: The exact number of scutes and tail-relative coordinates are local exemplar values. Host curvature is inferred.

proposals.name: Pedicled ribbed denticle field
proposals.discriminator: Each denticle rises on a buried pedicle to an exposed ribbed crown with a directed free margin. The continuous host skin remains visible between crowns at appropriate magnification.
proposals.next_review: Geometry is magnified for review. Exact overlap, scale flexibility and numerical riblet dimensions were not calibrated.

proposals.name: Recursive basket arm fork
proposals.discriminator: A skeletal arm divides repeatedly into separately curling daughter branches, preserving joints across each bifurcation.
proposals.next_review: The model includes two forks through a single shared mesh. More distal branch generations are omitted. Vertebral joint anatomy, small spines and load-dependent prey handling are outside scope. Angular controls are geometric poses, without independent joint constraints.

proposals.name: Byssal tether fan
proposals.discriminator: Several slender external tethers leave a common ventral notch and terminate separately in flat substrate plaques.
proposals.next_review: The tether fan uses 19 representative exterior tethers. It omits byssal fabrication, chemistry and internal attachments. Slack and spread are synthetic controls. Contact properties and tissue proportions are unverified.

proposals.name: Stalked dorsal elytral scale
proposals.discriminator: A broad flexible scale sits on a discrete underside stalk and overlaps scales on neighboring trunk segments.
proposals.next_review: Stalk thickness, offset and detailed ventral shape are inferred. Microscale papillae are simplified. The part is one scale, not the armored trunk.

proposals.name: Cubomedusan tentacle pedalium
proposals.discriminator: A flattened, branched blade runs from a bell corner and carries several tentacle seats away from the bell margin.
proposals.next_review: The draft stops at the seven seat ends. Full tentacles are outside scope. Internal structures and curvature in loaded poses are unresolved. Cross-sectional thickness and depth of the attachment inset are inferred.

proposals.name: Valve foramen pedicle
proposals.discriminator: A soft single stalk passes through a small rigid valve opening and broadens at the substrate attachment.
proposals.next_review: The part uses a local foramen sector. Both complete valves and internal musculature are outside scope. The distal contact, bend range and precise notch width require independent specimen views.

proposals.name: Ventral pouch opening
proposals.discriminator: A flexible rim surrounds an opening with depth and a directed entrance into a blind pocket. A projecting neck fold provides no route through the host surface into a bounded cavity.
proposals.next_review: The source is the common opossum and documents a different species than the brushtail possum queried in the queue. Depth, stretch and exact radius remain inferred. The isolated morph includes only the outer opening and inner wall.

proposals.name: Ventral tail contact strip
proposals.discriminator: A continuous distal ventral strip follows the inside of the coil and presents a compressed contact band to the branch. A uniformly skinned tail can coil without preserving a differentiated gripping surface.
proposals.next_review: Description confirms that the underside is naked. Contact-strip width, texture, and flattened cross-section remain inference. The single coil parameter produces geometric endpoints without grip friction or load simulation.

proposals.name: Limb girdle skin fold
proposals.discriminator: An external ridge has an adjacent deep crease running from a torso-fixed end onto the moving upper limb. In motion one lip can ride over the other while the continuous crease changes depth.
proposals.next_review: The lifelike fold location is source-supported. Independent simultaneous side views in opposing stride positions remain pending. The lower margin shifts with stride parameter as an inference, without simulated skin mechanics.

proposals.name: Paired shaft contour feather
proposals.discriminator: Two effective feather shafts leave one calamus and carry loose barbs in separate branches. Overlap depends on their shared root and paired distal silhouettes, distinct from neighboring single-shaft feathers.
proposals.next_review: The detailed barb extent, angles and shaft lengths are proxy values. An orthogonal calibrated image of a single feather remains pending. No flexible fabric or keratin mechanics are modeled.

proposals.name: Suction disc tarsal palette
proposals.discriminator: A broad flattened basal tarsal palette carries numerous stalked discs of visibly different sizes on its underside.
proposals.next_review: Arrangement outside the specimen crop is inferred. Disc counts are substantially coarsened. Surface fit, elastic sealing, and specimen joint travel are unverified.

proposals.name: Petalled pusher foot
proposals.discriminator: Paddle-like terminal flaps spread around a distal pusher-leg segment, increasing its contact area, and fold back alongside the segment.
proposals.next_review: Taper and process twist are authored from projected views. Degree and dynamics of the splay, contacts with sediment, and opposing-finger motion are unverified.

proposals.name: Antenniform feeling leg
proposals.discriminator: A conventional lateral leg socket and proximal segments carry a much elongated distal chain with numerous short flexible joints.
proposals.next_review: Tarsal segments are shown at reduced count. Depth, sweep and the tiny free tip are authored approximations. No measured living leg motion is claimed.

proposals.name: Eversible ventral tube pair
proposals.discriminator: A short cylindrical abdominal base bears two soft vesicles that evert through its distal rim to reach a contact surface.
proposals.next_review: The external short sleeve and two gross extension envelopes are modeled. Papillae, internal anatomy, inversion under pressure and dynamic adhesion are outside the scope.

proposals.name: Expandable trunk envelope
proposals.discriminator: The phenotype is a single skin envelope that expands around the trunk while fin roots and the anterior and posterior transitions remain constrained. A surface bulge leaves separate seams at these boundaries.
proposals.next_review: The two examples are different animals and views. Skin thickness, expansion ratios, and locations of pectoral and caudal attachments are inferred.

proposals.name: Ground contact pectoral crutch
proposals.discriminator: A short, fleshy pectoral lever puts the distal ray fan onto a load-bearing contact plane, with the fin root and elbow-like bend turning independently.
proposals.next_review: Individual skeletal elements and true pectoral-to-substrate kinematics are not recovered from the still views. Control angles and reconstructed cross-sections are qualitative.

proposals.name: Segmented caudad clasper
proposals.discriminator: An elongate male pelvic appendage forms a groove and articulates from the inner rear sector of the pelvic fin. It shares the fin attachment area while retaining a distinct free shaft.
proposals.next_review: The visible surface is simplified. Terminal texture, anatomical left/right hinge range, and cartilage segmentation are inferred. Direct comparative figure display was blocked by the publishers.

proposals.name: Modified anal ray gonopodium
proposals.discriminator: Selected anal rays form a narrow hinged bundle that swings forward while adjacent fin tissue retains its own attachment. Small terminal hooks or folds should be represented where visible.
proposals.next_review: Unmodeled small terminal structures, contact angles, and exact segment counts require a clear native-view adult macro.

proposals.name: Retractile circumanal gill wreath
proposals.discriminator: A ring of branchial plumes around a central opening shares a dorsal pocket and can withdraw as a group.
proposals.next_review: The collar and nine plumes depict one local gill assembly. Curvature and branch count are inferred and simplified. Extension is a static geometry control, with no live retraction path or water exchange model.

proposals.name: Open ended tusk shell
proposals.discriminator: A rigid curved shell forms a taper with open unequal ends and a continuous through-channel.
proposals.next_review: Radius, rib relief and fixed wall thickness are coarse inferences from external features. The generic through-bore omits small growth irregularities and internal shell changes.

proposals.name: Stalked jet nectophore
proposals.discriminator: An asymmetric lateral bell on a colony-axis seat contains a separately oriented outlet and can direct the jet away from its attachment axis.
proposals.next_review: The module includes the exterior seat, shell and short visible cavity. Internal canals are out of scope. Static tilt and constriction display different outlet geometry. They do not reproduce locomotion or fluid behavior.

proposals.name: Basal pedal attachment disc
proposals.discriminator: A broad continuous flange spreads from the whole base of a flexible column and conforms locally to an uneven substrate.
proposals.next_review: The model uses a localized lift parameter to vary the free edge. Basal contact face microstructure and adhesion are out of scope. A matched loaded edge-lift pose remains open.

proposals.name: Staggered ascidian siphon pair
proposals.discriminator: Two separately contractile apertures join one tunic patch at different heights and axes, with individually closing lobed lips.
proposals.next_review: The shared tunic stub and recesses are local. Opening controls are independent but stop short of full closure and do not simulate flow. Siphon-axis and lip-depth details are inferred.

proposals.name: Shared colonial cloacal rim
proposals.discriminator: Several separate zooid intake rims sit around a single shared external excurrent rim in a continuous low tunic sheet.
proposals.next_review: The nine-zooid module uses simplified exterior openings only. Shared internal channel, vascular structures and budding are outside scope. Tunic thickness and morphology of linked neighboring units remain unverified.

proposals.name: Valved dorsal spiracle
proposals.discriminator: A dorsal intake aperture sits just behind the eye and uses a recessed flap to open or seal the passage.
proposals.next_review: External shape has caption-level evidence. Internal flap cross-section, root and tested range are provisional. No fluid seal was tested.

proposals.name: Paired mobile mandibular rami
proposals.discriminator: Left and right lower jaw rami have independent posterior articulation and a compliant midline connection that widens as either ramus advances.
proposals.next_review: Ranges and advances are illustrative, not tissue measurements. The setting regenerates a compliant bridge between rami. Rigged skin-bridge deformation still needs validation.

proposals.name: Oral jet nozzle
proposals.discriminator: The tongue seats against a palatal channel and closes the sides of a short jet outlet that terminates at the mouth opening.
proposals.next_review: The internal channel is stylized. Published morphology supports a blowpipe hypothesis but does not completely settle the dynamic flow path. No water jet behavior is modeled.

proposals.name: Externally opening cheek pouch
proposals.discriminator: An external cheek slit leads into a blind, fur-lined pouch beside the mouth, forming a localized pocket with its own intake and independent fill volume.
proposals.next_review: Depth, internal wall, expansion and partial turning pose are inferred. A source for exact everted G. pinetis contour was not available.

proposals.name: Paired nectar trapping tongue
proposals.discriminator: Two elongated tongue grooves terminate in compliant edges and fringed tips that open in liquid and close through withdrawal.
proposals.next_review: Approximate shape of tip grooves and lamellae. No fluid loading and no held-out measurement of tip slit closure. Dimensions use a reusable part scale.

proposals.name: Inward claw bearing forefoot
proposals.discriminator: The long digit claws turn in beneath the forefoot while a dorsal knuckle contact bears weight. The contact plane and resting claw recess are on different sides of the flexed digit chain.
proposals.next_review: The elongated claw size order is source-backed. Relative skin and pad measures are proxy estimates. The static curl translates the claw tip with its digit envelope. Dynamic stance pressure and real contact are pending.

proposals.name: Split axis bark grip foot
proposals.discriminator: Two forward and two rear gripping rays originate in fore and aft pairs around one tarsal tip. These fixed opposition axes need joint placement distinct from a single opposable toe or a reversible outer talon.
proposals.next_review: The queue query names a great spotted woodpecker. The pileated example has a published posture description. The geometry models an outer toe pivot. Functional gripping, coupled hallux motion and pressure are pending.

proposals.name: Stridulating wing feather pair
proposals.discriminator: Two modified wing feathers include a ridged shaft region and an adjacent bent shaft that sweeps it. An aerodynamic feather array lacks a matching sliding contact pair.
proposals.next_review: The two features form the isolated local contact. Opposed wing motion, actual vibration, and the seventh secondary remain outside this draft. Ridge pitch and relative reach are uncalibrated. No acoustic claim is made for the draft.

proposals.name: Serrated primary leading edge
proposals.discriminator: Discrete curved comb teeth rise along the exposed leading edge of an outer primary. These tooth roots must stay in the vane edge under bend, separate from slots between adjacent feather tips.
proposals.next_review: The sample count is a draft. Absolute pitch and inclination need a registered specimen coupon. The model does not include flow or acoustic effects.

proposals.name: Interlocking feather vane patch
proposals.discriminator: Opposing barbule edges mate via visible hooks across the gap between adjacent barbs, producing a reversible seam inside one feather. Feather outlines and row overlap do not capture this interface.
proposals.next_review: The geometry is enlarged. Native barbule density, nanoscopic detail and material mechanics are omitted. The opening control moves the bars apart. Exact hook-to-flange collision geometry and phasing remain pending.

proposals.name: Contractile defense skirt
proposals.discriminator: A flexible perimeter around the spiny dorsal field contracts inward around the tucked underside. Closing the perimeter requires a deforming rim with inward roll, distinct from tilting individual spines.
proposals.next_review: The diagram supports the perimeter musculature. External lip variation and rate of closure remain uncalibrated. The geometry excludes the head and limbs. A tuck sequence and pressure fixture remain pending.

proposals.name: Posterior burrow plug
proposals.discriminator: A broad caudal shield follows the terminal pelvic contour and provides a continuous backward contact face above the flexed hindlimbs. A dorsal plate omits the vertical rump-to-tunnel fit.
proposals.next_review: No calibrated dorsal or caudal scan of the cutaneous structure was available. Absolute soft tissue dimensions and posterior shield thickness remain inferred. The built geometry models the external envelope. Inner plates and behavior remain outside the tested scope.

proposals.name: Hollow quill rattle
proposals.discriminator: Short hollow quills have expanded cup-like ends on narrow stalks. The movable tips need wall thickness and a shared collision envelope rather than the taper and fixed spacing of pointed spines.
proposals.next_review: The cup count and geometry are proxies. Exact wall thickness, sound, and free-space collisions are pending. One enlarged final cross section includes both inner and outer wall surfaces.

proposals.name: Tarsal spur socket
proposals.discriminator: A separate sheath projects from the tarsal shaft above the toe roots, seated around a raised spur base. A terminal claw rotates with a digit and cannot represent this mid-shaft insertion.
proposals.next_review: This draft uses domestic descendants as the directly measured reference for the red junglefowl queue query. The effect of age and species on length and curvature is pending. No contact or mechanical resistance is claimed.

proposals.name: Pendulous nasal vestibule
proposals.discriminator: A deep pendulous nasal vestibule overhangs the upper mouth and supports two separately rimmed, anteroventral airway entries around a central slope.
proposals.next_review: The external silhouette was observed. Left-right opening shapes and the soft tissue cutout depth need matching frontal and underside references. No airflow simulated.

proposals.name: Interdigitating sieve teeth
proposals.discriminator: Deep lobes and narrow gaps in the opposing postcanine rows interdigitate to leave a repeatable draining passage when the mouth is almost closed.
proposals.next_review: The anatomical specimen shows a static gap. Exact tooth counts, upper-to-lower offset and drain paths under biting load remain unverified.

proposals.name: Radial crushing tooth plates
proposals.discriminator: Broad opposing mineralized tooth plates radiate from medial roots as connected ridges with valleys between them and meet across a crushing face.
proposals.next_review: The source establishes ridge arrangements at different developmental stages. Reciprocal adult engagement and the jaw fixture remain unverified.

proposals.name: Overlapping acoustic tegmina
proposals.discriminator: Overlapping dorsal wings put a raised scraper opposite an underside file alongside an expanded resonating wing panel.
proposals.next_review: The draft coarsens files and veins and uses authored opening and raising angles. True tooth contact, flex, acoustic output and source-normalized measurements are unverified.

proposals.name: Rolling overlap tergite row
proposals.discriminator: Adjacent arched tergites and their lateral flanges maintain overlap as the ventral joints flex and the dorsal series wraps around a tight curve.
proposals.next_review: The shell series is an authored three-ring local patch. Articulatory stop geometry and continuous interplate clearance remain unverified.

proposals.name: Paired antennal breathing tube
proposals.discriminator: Two forward antennae align their opposed setal margins into a temporary tube continuous with a groove between the eyes.
proposals.next_review: The open range, coarse bristle geometry and clearance are authored. Tube closure and water transport are unverified.

proposals.name: Subchelate palm fold
proposals.discriminator: A single hinged dactyl presses across a broad propodal palm with a stepped contact margin and no projecting fixed finger.
proposals.next_review: One projection constrains the prominent palm and curved dactyl. Their thickness, true closed contact and lateral play are inferred.

proposals.name: Asymmetric shell holdfast
proposals.discriminator: Unequal terminal uropods bend into the shell interior, presenting coarse rasp surfaces on an offset twist of the terminal abdomen.
proposals.next_review: Gross lateral asymmetry is supported by the drawings and text. The texture pattern, detailed pad thickness, and contact under load on a shell columella are inferred.

proposals.name: Interlocking dorsal spines
proposals.discriminator: A stout leading spine locks in its raised pose when the second spine engages its base. The paired pivots and contact surfaces define the assembly.
proposals.next_review: Internal lock surfaces are inferred from family-level comparative osteology. Species-matched lock geometry and fully seated folded pose remain pending.

proposals.name: Folding peduncular scalpel
proposals.discriminator: A laterally mounted blade hinges from a body groove on the caudal peduncle. Blade deployment exposes a cutting edge and leaves a visible recessed seat.
proposals.next_review: Soft tissue mechanics and species-matched deployment extremes are inferred. The surface and edges are rounded for visual review.

proposals.name: Barbed caudal sting
proposals.discriminator: A flattened, serrated blade has an extended root running along the dorsal tail surface. The exposed edges and tail seat require a different construction from a terminal tapering sting.
proposals.next_review: Relief is stylized at coarse scale. Edge counts, contact with a bending tail, and tissue detail remain unverified.

proposals.name: Ceratal field
proposals.discriminator: Separate tapered papillae emerge in dense staggered rows from lateral mantle surfaces along a body section.
proposals.next_review: The modeled field uses two representative fascicles, with individual positions and angles inferred. Texture, coloration and internal features are omitted. The distinction from repeated generic tentacles is the graded multirow seat on one local body flank. If an existing field placement mechanism yields the same result, this draft can merge.

proposals.name: Sediment lunule test sector
proposals.discriminator: An elongated full-depth window interrupts a flattened rigid test and carries a rounded load-bearing rim through the wall.
proposals.next_review: Only one lunule and its surrounding skeletal sector are modeled. Spines, grooves and tissue are omitted. This shares perforated-shell construction with the abalone vent row. A separate family remains conditional on an independently supported asymmetric oral and aboral rim and broad test-sector fit.

proposals.name: Perianal tooth ring
proposals.discriminator: Five spaced rigid plates project from the rear margin of a soft extensible aperture, leaving clear gaps between their free tips.
proposals.next_review: The five-tooth arrangement is supported. Exact terminal morphology and changes through closure are open. This is an exterior opening ring with no internal tissue. The single control varies spread in the soft rim and relative position of the teeth.

proposals.name: Everting jaw crown
proposals.discriminator: A soft sleeve rolls through the mouth rim and presents four hook jaws radially on its newly exposed distal crown.
proposals.next_review: This static local draft represents the external cuff and visible tips only. The final extrusion path, detailed folds and through-stroke gape remain pending.

proposals.name: Pinnate polyp bearing leaf
proposals.discriminator: A soft triangular lateral leaf carries several independent polyp seats along a common plate rooted on a colony rachis.
proposals.next_review: The draft includes one leaf and short polyp cups. Whole colony and full fine tentacles are omitted. Exact leaf-to-rachis curvature, independent polyp extension and local fit remain open.

proposals.name: Eversible scalid introvert
proposals.discriminator: An eversible anterior sleeve exposes several ordered rows of outward hooks around the cylindrical body surface.
proposals.next_review: The exposed introvert is local only. Five example bands preserve the regular spatial arrangement at preview scale. No internal structures are modeled. Protrusion is a static profile control, and live retraction remains open.

proposals.name: Projectile tongue skeleton
proposals.discriminator: An internal tongue skeleton is carried out into a projected stalk ending in an expanded adhesive pad; a distinct oral storage section accommodates the retracted assembly.
proposals.next_review: The internal support struts are displayed for inspection. Excursion, tissue thickness and length ratios are inferred. The projector mechanism is outside the scope of this draft.

proposals.name: Gape interlocking mandibular tusks
proposals.discriminator: A flattened mandibular tooth rises outside the upper jaw and then curls along its rostrum, imposing a narrow limit on the closed-to-open gape.
proposals.next_review: Tooth root depth and dorsal overcross are approximate. No jaw-stop angle or mechanical bite limit was validated.

proposals.name: Erectile nectar brush tongue
proposals.discriminator: A distal brush consists of many rows of coarse papillae that lie back in the retracted pose and stand off the tongue during nectar collection.
proposals.next_review: Papilla count is coarsened and blood-vessel-driven erection is represented as a pose control. No fluid stroke has been simulated.

proposals.name: Postincisor oral seal
proposals.discriminator: Facial lip folds meet behind externally exposed incisors, allowing the teeth to protrude and contact substrate while the oral entrance seals behind them.
proposals.next_review: Fold thickness, incisor position and occlusion are coarse. Host anatomy and interaction with excavation substrate remain untested.

proposals.name: Intracranial jaw hinge
proposals.discriminator: The anterior upper skull segment rocks relative to the posterior braincase around a second joint above the mandibular hinge, exposing a split across the roof.
proposals.next_review: The blocks are schematic. Exact live articulation and gape coupling have conflicting interpretations and are unverified here. A lower jaw is outside this isolated model.

proposals.name: Swallowing orbit plunger
proposals.discriminator: The eye descends into an orbital opening and deforms the roof of the mouth as a broad contact surface during swallowing.
proposals.next_review: Model uses past taxon name only in cited article title. Globe drive, contact tissue mechanics, and prey displacement are approximate.

proposals.name: Distal bill flexure
proposals.discriminator: A long upper bill bends in its distal region and opens a local tip gape while the narrow basal bill stays nearly closed.
proposals.next_review: The photograph documents one position. Neutral profile, cross sections and in-substrate clearance are inferred. Runtime motion and specimen-relative fit remain pending.

proposals.name: Split waterline compound eye
proposals.discriminator: Two externally separate compound-eye lobes occupy upper and lower surfaces of one lateral head seat, with a continuous intervening rim at the waterline.
proposals.next_review: Species-labeled lateral SEM and genus-level dorsal and ventral microscopy support the external geometry. Corneal facet size, host fit, waterline sightlines and calibrated lateral likeness remain open.

proposals.name: Vertical fang chelicera
proposals.discriminator: A robust basal cheliceral segment carries a separately hinged fang that folds into its ventral groove and sweeps in a near fore-aft plane.
proposals.next_review: An opened pair is visible in the close-up. Groove depth, anatomical hinge axes, enclosed pose clearance and a matched silhouette remain unmeasured.

proposals.name: Sliding sabre ovipositor
proposals.discriminator: Several longitudinal valves form a laterally flattened blade and slide relative to one another along shared interfaces.
proposals.next_review: The blade length and valve stroke are authored relative dimensions. Internal guide grooves, substrate clearance, measured slip and matched lateral likeness remain open.

proposals.name: Lateral abdominal display flaps
proposals.discriminator: Bilateral soft side flaps spread from a raised central abdominal plate into a broad display fan, then wrap close against the abdominal sides.
proposals.next_review: The draft captures gross shape in clay. The display cuticle contour, fold axis, folds against a scaled host and calibrated front/profile likeness remain open.

proposals.name: Paired shell aperture valves
proposals.discriminator: Two mirrored sets of scutal and tergal plates occupy a shell aperture and move together to close it along a central seam.
proposals.next_review: The fixed soft seat and plate articulation are coarse inferences. Aperture fit with the cirral fan, matching mineral contours and soft closure remain open.

proposals.name: Multicirral filter fan
proposals.discriminator: Several serial pairs of jointed biramous cirri deploy together through a narrow shell opening and curve into a three-dimensional cup.
proposals.next_review: The source frames show active and passive extension and terminal outlines. The gross curve and coarse setae are inferred in depth. Root packaging, live flex, calibrated length ratios and setal density remain open.

proposals.name: Nested antennal shovels
proposals.discriminator: Successive antenna segments are flattened into overlapping plates, with an expanded free edge and an articulated seat ahead of the eyes.
proposals.next_review: The overhead illustration exposes the outline and overlap but not the hidden articulation or plate underside. Cephalic fit, opposite-antenna clearance and measured thickness remain open.

proposals.name: Folding fringe swimming oar
proposals.discriminator: An elongated flattened tibia and tarsus bear a directional fringe that spreads into a blade and collapses along the leg for recovery.
proposals.next_review: The same-family Corixa punctata replaces the initial Sigara striata reference because its tarsal plates and fringe motions are documented. Hairs and joint range are coarsened. Hydrodynamic output and flexible contact are unverified.

proposals.name: Eversible palpal adhesive pad
proposals.discriminator: A flexible adhesive face projects from the distal palp and folds back into a bordered terminal recess.
proposals.next_review: Galeodes araneoides is an observed congener of the original G. arabs lead. The static pose control approximates exposure. Internal inversion, adhesive action, and detailed cuticle remain unverified.

proposals.name: Setal antennal capture scoop
proposals.discriminator: Paired second antennae extend as curved setose scoops that project ahead of a buried head and fold inward toward its ventral side.
proposals.next_review: Only one antenna is authored and can be mirrored. Depth, exact feather count and folded oral reach remain inferred. Capture performance is unverified.

proposals.name: Joined terminal median fin rim
proposals.discriminator: Dorsal and anal fin membranes continue around the very tip through a caudal sector, preserving continuous ray-supported edging across a tight reversal. Verify whether a linked extension of the axial membrane draft can cover the terminal seam.
proposals.next_review: Ray relief stands in for pliable ray structure. Side-to-side thickness, exact ray attachments and 3D ray paths are inferred. Species-matched bent close-up remains unavailable.

proposals.name: Unicorn spiral horn
proposals.discriminator: A forehead horn with surface spiral relief around its axis. The twisted surface differs from a sweep or coiled ram horn.
proposals.next_review: The forehead mounting, enlarged spiral relief and final curvature belong to the original fantasy design. Fit on a forehead and measured design correspondence remain pending.

proposals.name: Wyvern tail spade
proposals.discriminator: A flattened bilateral tail-end blade on a single continuous shank, with swept shoulders and one distal point.
proposals.next_review: The hooked shoulders and stylized thickness belong to the fantasy design. Exported tail articulation and clearance under large neighboring tail bends remain pending.

proposals.name: Dragon cheek frill
proposals.discriminator: Compact lateral cheek web with raised radiating ridges and scalloped margins, mirrored across the head in recipes.
proposals.next_review: Cheek mounting, four fantasy support ridges and three scallops are design choices. Spread is a shape control. Host clearance, driven motion and calibrated design likeness remain pending.

proposals.name: Suid rostral disc
proposals.discriminator: A flared working face with paired forward-facing recessed vestibules and a full thick rim needs a distinct terminal outline and recess geometry.
proposals.next_review: Verify rim projection and nostril orientation on calibrated side and frontal views of the same living animal. Fixed tissue and close perspective can alter the apparent outline. Airway continuation and pad deformation are unverified.

proposals.name: Bovine four-quarter udder
proposals.discriminator: The broad ventral seat, paired quarter relief and four continuous teat branches are outside a generic bulk primitive.
proposals.next_review: Match calibrated side and rear views of one cow to resolve the upper attachment shape, fore/hind quarter proportions and effects of lactation or breed. Hind legs and fore udder continuity are partly obscured in the current views.

proposals.name: Chicken single comb
proposals.discriminator: A midline cranial seat with a fleshy continuous web, uneven points and a free blade is distinct from a dorsal body crest.
proposals.next_review: Measure comb crest and seat in independent orthogonal views of one specified breed. Thickness, small surface bumps and natural flop during movement are unverified.

proposals.name: Chicken paired wattles
proposals.discriminator: Two lobes drop from bilateral cranial seats with a full-length medial gap. A dewlap is a single throat fold.
proposals.next_review: Acquire a straight-on specimen view with both root lines and a calibrated side view. Jaw-open behavior, gravity-driven asymmetry and thickness are inferred.

proposals.name: Square-stop canine muzzle
proposals.discriminator: The existing fox-derived muzzle tapers gradually beyond the cheek pads. The draft holds tip breadth, changes the curvature into an explicit stop and straight bridge, and seats two rimmed nostrils above a closed lip commissure.
proposals.next_review: Nose leather, nostril floor and oral depth are stylized. Closed-mouth only. A registered side silhouette and another measured frontal specimen remain pending.

proposals.name: Pendulous folded pinna
proposals.discriminator: The upright outward-facing cup in ear_pinna cannot make a close-hanging ear with a continuous basal rollover, thin distal flap and asymmetric turned leading edge by changing cup or flatness.
proposals.next_review: The hidden auricular concha, underside thickness and exact basal fold remain inferred. The available photographs show a static drape. Dynamic ear carriage remains pending.

proposals.name: Bilateral mystacial pads
proposals.discriminator: The whiskers family emits a unilateral boss with an upright fan of fibres. The generic muzzle has subdued cheek swellings. The draft uses one broad attachment seat and two short lobe fields with integrated follicle dimples and a medial furrow.
proposals.next_review: Exact follicle count, concealed lower pad contours and fur compression are undetermined. The photographs do not provide calibrated profile depth or active whisking movement.

proposals.name: Elongate lagomorph hindfoot
proposals.discriminator: The carnivoran paw emphasizes a short rounded metapodium and discrete plantar pads. The draft elongates and lowers the heel-to-toe body, keeps the plantar surface continuous, and branches into four low unequal distal digits.
proposals.next_review: The skeletal views support segment proportions and toe count. True soft-tissue cross-sections, interdigital depths, sole shape under load and toe motion remain unmeasured.
